_note: 學習路徑內容：集合名詞（eng.t_mid.noun.collective，會考級／中階）。team／family／class／government 指一群人為一個單位。英美差異（誠實教＋誠實標）：美式英語集合名詞多配單數動詞（The team is winning.）；英式英語在著眼個別成員時可配複數動詞（The team are arguing.）。為避免兩可，practice 一律明確框定『In American English』再問動詞，答案唯一；英式用法於 teach 與 claim 中誠實呈現。R14 用英文學英文，中文對照收合於 zh_hint。規則依 Cambridge／Oxford／Swan，標 provisional＋待英語母語 reviewer 複核。無音檔。

units.title_zh: 集合名詞（單複數動詞搭配）
units.can_do: 我知道 team／family／class／government 是集合名詞（指一群人為一個單位），也知道美式英語多配單數動詞、英式英語著眼成員時可配複數動詞，並能在美式語境選出正確動詞。
units.situation_group: 名詞：集合名詞 Collective nouns
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A collective noun names a group of people or things as one unit: team, family, class, government, committee.
claims.verification_ref: 集合名詞指一群人／物為一個單位：team、family、class、government、committee；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In American English, a collective noun usually takes a singular verb: 'The team is winning.' 'The class has a test today.'
claims.verification_ref: 美式英語集合名詞通常配單數動詞：The team is winning.；The class has a test today.；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In British English, a collective noun can take a plural verb when the speaker is thinking of the individual members: 'The team are arguing among themselves.'
claims.verification_ref: 英式英語著眼個別成員時可配複數動詞：The team are arguing among themselves.；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Within one sentence, keep the verb and pronoun consistent. If the verb is singular, use a singular pronoun: 'The committee has made its decision.' Do not mix singular and plural for the same noun.
claims.verification_ref: 同句中動詞與代名詞數要一致：The committee has made its decision.（單數動詞＋單數代名詞 its）；不可單複數混用；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A collective noun names a group as one unit: team, family, class, government, committee. The group has many members but is spoken of as a single thing.
teach.zh_hint: 集合名詞把一群人當成一個單位來稱呼：team、family、class、government、committee。這個群體有很多成員，但被當作一個整體來講。

teach.body: American English usually uses a singular verb: 'The team is winning.' British English can use a plural verb when thinking of the members: 'The team are arguing among themselves.'
teach.zh_hint: 美式英語通常用單數動詞：The team is winning.（這支隊伍正在贏。）英式英語在著眼個別成員時可用複數動詞：The team are arguing among themselves.（隊員們彼此在爭吵。）

teach.body: Whichever style you use, stay consistent in one sentence. If the verb is singular, use a singular pronoun too: 'The committee has made its decision.' Do not mix, like 'has ... their'.
teach.zh_hint: 不論用哪種風格，同一句要前後一致。動詞用單數，代名詞也用單數：The committee has made its decision.（委員會已做出它的決定。）不要混用成 has…their。

practice.stem: Which word is a collective noun (it names a whole group)?

distractor_rationales.player: player 是一個球員（單一個人），不是一群人的集合名詞。
distractor_rationales.ball: ball 是一顆球（單一物品），不是集合名詞。
distractor_rationales.field: field 是球場（地點），不是一群人的集合名詞。

practice.feedback: team（隊伍）把一群球員當成一個單位，是集合名詞。

practice.stem: Which of these is also a collective noun?

distractor_rationales.loud: loud 是形容詞（大聲的），不是名詞。
distractor_rationales.run: run 是動詞（跑），不是集合名詞。
distractor_rationales.under: under 是介系詞（在…下方），不是名詞。

practice.feedback: government（政府）指一群人組成的單位，是集合名詞。

practice.stem: In American English, choose the correct verb: 'The team ____ winning the game.'

distractor_rationales.are: 美式英語集合名詞通常配單數動詞 is；are 是英式著眼成員時的用法，不是這裡框定的美式標準答案。
distractor_rationales.am: am 只用於 I，不能配 the team。
distractor_rationales.be: be 是原形，不能直接當這句的動詞，需要 is。

practice.feedback: 美式英語：The team is winning.（集合名詞配單數動詞 is）。

practice.stem: In American English, choose the correct verb: 'The class ____ a test today.'

distractor_rationales.have: 美式英語集合名詞通常配單數動詞 has；have 是英式著眼成員時的用法，不是這裡框定的美式標準答案。
distractor_rationales.having: having 是現在分詞，不能單獨當這句的動詞。
distractor_rationales.haves: haves 不是正確的動詞形式。

practice.feedback: 美式英語：The class has a test today.（集合名詞配單數動詞 has）。

practice.stem: Which sentence keeps the verb and pronoun consistent (both singular)?
practice.answer: The committee has finished its report.
options: The committee has finished its report.
The committee has finished their report.
The committee have finished its report.
The committee is finished their report.

has 是單數，their 是複數，單複數混用了。
have 是複數，its 是單數，單複數混用了。
is finished 語意不對（應為 has finished），而且 is（單數）配 their（複數）又不一致。

practice.feedback: has（單數）＋its（單數）前後一致。（英式若整句用複數 have…their 也可一致，但本題只提供這一個一致選項。）
